name: Home view loads with greeting and navigation
expect: The dashboard should be fully loaded with the dark theme, showing a greeting 'Good [time], Matias', the MTW logo in the sidebar, and navigation items

name: KPI cards are rendered on home view
expect: The dashboard home view should be visible with KPI cards if Anthropic is configured, or the providers onboarding view

name: Today's Focus and Recent Activity panels render
expect: Dashboard main content area and sidebar should be present and rendering

name: Tasks view shows status and priority bars
expect: The Tasks view should display bar charts for By Status (todo, in_progress, done, blocked) and By Priority (urgent, high, medium, low)

name: People view shows contact analytics
expect: The People view should show KPI cards (Total, With Email, With Phone, No Interaction), coverage grid with percentages, and bar charts for By Relationship and By Source

name: Reminders view renders
expect: The Reminders view should display KPI cards (Active, Snoozed, Fired Today, Recurring), Overdue and Upcoming 24h panels, and a By Status bar chart

name: Shopping view renders
expect: The Shopping view should show Low Stock and Active Lists panels with relevant data or empty state messages

name: Analytics view shows pipeline and network
expect: The Analytics view should show Semantic Search panel, Pipeline Status (3 layers with dots), Network Overview with node/rel/group counts, and Influencers & Communities panels

name: API health endpoint returns OK
expect: The browser should display raw JSON containing status: ok, uptimeMs, and uptimeFormatted fields

name: API dashboard endpoint returns full JSON
expect: The browser should display raw JSON with the full dashboard payload including generatedAt, kpis, tasks, crm, reminders, and shopping sections
